Class ShamanMalusEventBuilding

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.buildings.Building
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.buildings.types.ShamanMalusEventBuilding
public class ShamanMalusEventBuilding extends Building
Represents a shaman malus event building card in the game. Extends the Building class and applies its specific effect related to shaman malus events. Allows operations through the visitor pattern.
